true_answer: Consider the statement, “For all natural numbers n , if n is prime, then n is solitary.” You do not need to know what solitary means for this problem, just that it is a property that some numbers have and others do not. (a) Write the converse and the contrapositive of the statement, say- ing which is which. Note: the original statement claims that an implication is true for all n , and it is that implication that we are taking the converse and contrapositive of.
